job_id_hint: the hub picks it before starting, e.g. slot-app-20261013-0900, and passes --job-id; "auto" = slot-app-<date-time>
title: PeakPack for Mac - app slot: PEAK (Modded).app download, first run, Steam console game step, daily launch, options (modded and normal), repair and uninstall
requester: PeakPack for Mac (MacPort lead) - Joshua's project

machine.screen: ours for the whole slot (computer-use steps click in PEAK (Modded), in Steam's Console view, and in the app's menus)
needs: Rosetta 2 (hub: installed; if missing, G-APP1 exits needs-human and Joshua installs it with macOS's own prompt)
Mac Steam running under fleet, signed in once with Remember me (H-STEAM; the kit never reads Steam login/config files)
Run INSIDE fleet's logged-in GUI (Aqua) session: launchctl managername must print Aqua; from a remote shell every app gate ends BLOCKED (exit 2)
screen recording + input control for the hub's tooling (computer-use steps)
about 6 GB free on the disk for the app, its runtime, the prefix and the game download (1.93 GB)
optional: Xcode Command Line Tools: NOT required (the arm64/x86_64 lipo check is skipped without them)

release.note: app_release is the pin for the APP gates (passed to each gate as --app-release; G-APP1 saves it to the job's job.env). mac-build-app-0.1.2 is published (polish pass); bump it here for newer app builds. tag is the kit's runtime release, which no app gate uses (run_slot passes it as --release).

app.launch: open -n "$JOB/apps/PEAK (Modded).app" --args --data-dir $JOB/appdata --skip-update-check --uninstall-to $JOB/uninstalled [--no-autoplay | --options | nothing for a Dock-click start]
app.verification: every zip is checked against the release's SHA256SUMS by lib/app.sh (ensure_app); the game depot is checked file by file against expect/peak-win-<version>-*.manifest when the version matches

kit.setup: JOB=~/peakpack-test/<job_id>; mkdir -p $JOB/kit && curl -fsSL <source_archive> | tar -xz -C $JOB/kit --strip-components=2 peakpack-mac-testkit-0.3.5/mac && cd $JOB/kit   (the kit then lives at $JOB/kit/testkit; cleanup.sh removes it with the job dir)
kit.invoke_as: bash testkit/<script>.sh (never rely on exec bits)

job_dir: ~/peakpack-test/<job_id>  (everything is written here; exceptions listed under outside_paths)

how_to_run.all_in_one: cd $JOB/kit && bash testkit/run_slot.sh testkit/slot-app.job.json --job-id <job_id> > $JOB/run_slot-console.txt 2>&1 &   (background; watch requests with: bash testkit/cu.sh $JOB wait). The app gates take the release from the slot's gate args: --app-release mac-build-app-0.1.2
how_to_run.computer_use: scripts print [CU-REQUEST] lines and write <job-dir>/cu/<gate>.<step>.request; do the steps in gates/<gate>.md (section CU-<step>), then answer: bash testkit/cu.sh <job-dir> done <gate>.<step> ok|fail|skip "note" [key=value ...]

gates.title: Mac Steam running (no login files read)
gates.needs_human: only if Steam is not running and a sign-in window appears when the hub opens it
gates.pass: steam_osx running. Signed-in is proven by G-B1 and by G-APP1's steam step, not here
gates.on_fail: exit 3: the hub may run `open -a Steam` (no credentials), wait ~30 s and re-run H-STEAM; only a sign-in window needs Joshua

gates.title: PEAK (Modded).app: download and verify, static checks, first run up to the game step
gates.needs_human: only if Rosetta 2 is missing (exit 3; Joshua installs it with macOS's prompt) or the app waits more than 3 min at its steam step (Mac Steam not signed in under fleet)
gates.pass: zip matches SHA256SUMS; unpacks; codesign --verify --deep --strict; lipo arm64+x86_64 (with CLT, else skipped); LSMinimumSystemVersion 12.0; NSMicrophoneUsageDescription; --version; --print-status schema 1 with nextStep; welcome reached; Set Up PEAK clicked (agent); the app reaches step game (waiting for user) with runtime id, prefix stamp and no problem; the app keeps running
gates.on_fail: continue (G-APP2 to G-APP6 are blocked by their requires)

gates.title: PEAK (Modded).app game step: Steam console paste, verify, PeakPack and mods, quit
gates.pass: app phase done ('All set') within 100 min; PEAK.exe, UnityPlayer.dll, steam_api64.dll, Assembly-CSharp.dll in appdata/prefix/drive_c/Games/PEAK; every file's SHA-256 equals the Windows reference when version.txt matches (2.6.b); status manifestId a number and equal to Steam's console manifest; PeakPack.exe and BepInEx core installed; packRevision in state.json; depot gone from Steam's content folder; app quit
gates.on_fail: continue (G-APP3 is blocked by its requires)

gates.title: PEAK (Modded).app daily launch (Dock-click start) to the main menu
gates.pass: launching then playing; PEAK.exe runs; Player.log 'Steam runtime manager initialized: True'; main menu fully drawn (agent); PEAK ends from its menu (or wineserver -k fallback); the app quits by itself within 60 s; status lastLaunch is modded; no problem
gates.on_fail: continue (G-APP4 is blocked by its requires)

gates.title: PEAK (Modded).app options window: Show FPS, Play with Mods, plugins load, Metal HUD
computer_use: options (Show FPS on, Play with Mods)
gates.pass: BepInEx chainloader complete after the click; every 'N plugins to load' plugin loaded; no BepInEx load errors; every name in expect/pack-plugins.txt loaded; status lastLaunch is modded; Metal HUD visible (agent, fps recorded); PEAK ends; Show FPS unticked; app quit
gates.on_fail: continue (G-APP5 is blocked by its requires)

gates.title: PEAK (Modded).app Play Normal PEAK: vanilla launch, no BepInEx
gates.pass: PEAK.exe runs; Player.log 'Steam runtime manager initialized'; LogOutput.log not rewritten; no BepInEx/Doorstop/Chainloader text in Player.log; status lastLaunch is vanilla; PEAK ends; app quit
gates.on_fail: continue (G-APP6 is blocked by its requires)

gates.title: PEAK (Modded).app repair (damaged stamp and runtime file) and uninstall (moved out of the job)
computer_use: uninstall (PEAK menu > Uninstall > Move to Trash)
gates.pass: prefix stamp and runtime file restored (original SHA-256; manifest entry when listed); status no problem; --print-status readyToPlay true; appdata gone after Uninstall; uninstalled/appdata-* has runtime/ and prefix/; app bundle still in the job; Steam content, downloading and depotcache listings unchanged; app quit

human_steps.when: already done (Mac Steam signed in under fleet with Remember me, per slot1)
human_steps.what: nothing else in this slot; if H-STEAM exits 3 (signed out) or G-APP1 waits at the steam step, Joshua signs in to Steam under fleet

human_steps.when: only if G-APP1 exits 3 for Rosetta 2
human_steps.what: install Rosetta 2 with macOS's own prompt (his administrator password); the kit and the agent never click it or type a password

human_steps.when: after the slot, if he wants the quarantine path tested
human_steps.what: copy the app downloaded with a browser (quarantined) and open it by hand; Open Anyway may ask for an administrator password (never typed by the agent)

human_steps.when: only if a macOS privacy prompt appears (microphone from PEAK, files)
human_steps.what: decides the prompt; the agent takes it as dialog-<n> and never clicks Allow

later_slots: none for the app gates; slot1.job.json (the Windows PeakPack gates), slot3.job.json (G-X1, H-MIC; humans), slot4.job.json (G-C0, optional G-A2-CX)
outside_paths: ~/Library/Application Support/Steam/[Steam.AppBundle/Steam/Contents/MacOS/]steamapps/content/app_3527290 (the app's download_depot; the app moves the depot into $JOB/appdata; G-APP2 checks it is gone; cleanup.sh removes an empty leftover, if the job created it)
~/Library/Application Support/Steam/[...]/depotcache/3527291_*.manifest (Steam writes it during the download; G-APP2 records new ones; cleanup.sh removes them)
/tmp/.wine-<uid>/server-<dev>-<inode> (Wine server socket of the app's prefix, $JOB/appdata/prefix; removed by cleanup.sh)

~/Library/* paths written by PEAK (Modded).app itself (Preferences, Caches, Application Support, Logs): NOT YET KNOWN. The first run is to be listed here; cleanup.sh does not know them yet (see gates/APP-README.md, Known limits)
Steam-side records of playtime / 'Playing PEAK' on Joshua's account (server-side, expected)
macOS-managed caches: Rosetta AOT translations (/var/db/oah), Metal shader caches (per-user temp) - system-managed, not removed

contains: logs/<gate>/ (console.log, LogOutput-modded.log, Player logs, codesign.txt, print-status JSON, manifests)
also_copy: $JOB/appdata/Logs/ (the app's own logs: PEAK Modded.log, prefix.log, peakpack.log, launcher.log, wine/)
$JOB/uninstalled/appdata-*/ (the moved copy, from G-APP6; its Logs/ and frontend/status.json)
evidence/<gate>/*.png (the agent's screenshots are saved with cu.sh shot)
copy_back.also_relay: the agent's answers for every CU step, and the run_slot console output

removes: our Wine processes (the app's prefix, wineserver -k) and anything started from the job dir; PEAK (Modded).app's own processes are stopped by G-APP6's app_quit or pkill
Steam depot content/download folders and depotcache files created by this job
the job dir including the kit ($JOB/kit), the app bundle ($JOB/apps), the app data ($JOB/appdata) and $JOB/uninstalled
leaves: anything that existed before the job

scheduling_note: The app slot needs Joshua only for Rosetta 2 (if missing) and for a Steam sign-in (if signed out). Otherwise it runs unattended in the fleet's GUI session. The Steam console paste (G-APP2) is done by the agent with computer use, so the screen must be ours for the whole slot.
